history.alt_text: A matte clay mechanical assembly of a pristine AC condenser connected to a fractured ventilation duct, resting on concrete.
history.caption: Duct leaks dictate the true efficiency of a home HVAC system, regardless of the unit's factory SEER2 rating.
history.title: HVAC Duct Leak Efficiency Penalty

style_when: the news is structural and abstract — a stack reordered, a layer added, a flow rerouted — and there is no literal object that carries it, so the idea is stated as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts rather than as bare shapes
prompt: A matte clay 3D render of a mechanical HVAC assembly resting on weathered concrete. Extreme asymmetry, the hero assembly placed off-centre on the right third, surrounded by generous negative space. The assembly consists of three recognisable engineered parts: a pristine square condenser block, a connecting transition manifold, and a fractured, disjointed ventilation duct section featuring a visible structural gap. Constructed from matte muted grey and pale blue polymers with visible moulding seams and deep contact shadows. A single sharp directional key light rakes across the assembly from the left, throwing a long cast shadow over the textured concrete surface. No abstract bare shapes, no text, no embossed lettering.
negative_prompt: text, garbled letters, watermarks, typography, logos, UI, plain spheres, simple cubes
rationale: The structural reality of factory efficiency being lost in distribution is best represented as a small physical assembly of recognisable parts. A clay render isolates the mechanical relationship between the unit and the leaking delivery system.
cue: 20% of your home's air conditioning (AC) never arrives
subject: a mechanical assembly of a pristine AC condenser connected to a fractured duct segment
core_thesis: The true efficiency of a home AC system is dictated by duct leakage and airflow, not the factory SEER2 rating on the quote.
core_conflict: Promised factory efficiency rating vs. real-world physical loss in the delivery system
composition: extreme asymmetry, hero assembly off-centre on the right

caption: The 20 Percent Duct Leak: Why home ducts waste a fifth of your cooling energy.
title: The 20 Percent Duct Leak
